summary: The DIS-level material sits at the right level and derives its special cases, but the new CommRing section in the upstream-style BilinMap file carries hypotheses stronger than Mathlib's own convention requires, and fromG1G2_ne_zero reproves the (0,0) case of fromG1G2_injective instead of deriving it.
